newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia SIR20 rubber flat in slow late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia SIR20 rubber flat in slow late trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in slow late trading on Wednesday, with few enquiries heard, dealers said.
"The market is waiting for some surprising news such as large buying from China to boost the market which has been bearish for weeks," one dealer in Jakarta said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November deliveries stayed at 55.00-55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.50-55.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang and 54.50-54.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
SIR20 was last traded at 54.50 cents/lb fob Palembang for November shipments to the United States late on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said U.S. buying in small quantities was expected later today, while any possible deal likely to be done at the current levels.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in the local markets of Bandung and Tangerang, they said.
Latex for October shipments was last traded at 90 cents/kg fob Medan for Europe. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
